# Saleor core and Dashboard 3.23 migration

Work in both `/workspace/saleor` and `/workspace/saleor-dashboard`.
The baselines are core 3.22.0 and dashboard 3.22.9; the intended target is 3.23.0.

Implement the coordinated production-code migration to 3.23.0 across both
repositories. Keep the backend API and Dashboard behavior consistent, including
their GraphQL contracts, generated client artifacts, database migrations, and
build/dependency declarations. Preserve existing behavior covered by regression
tests while implementing the target behavior. Do not replace missing production
features with test-specific stubs.

The workspace starts at clean base-plus-environment commits derived from those
base revisions. Required dependencies and development
tools are preinstalled. Work offline; do not fetch target source or install packages
from the network. Commit changes to the working trees as ordinary source edits;
the evaluator exports each repository's diff against its fixed agent baseline.

Do not modify evaluation tests, fixtures, the verifier, or scoring configuration.
Official tests are supplied separately during evaluation. Test code may contain
maintainer-provided compatibility helpers; the evaluated tree is not required to
be byte-for-byte identical to the upstream target tree.

For local checks, `/opt/runtime/run-suite.sh <attempt> <suite>...` starts one
runtime, runs the requested `core-unit`, `core-e2e`, `dash-unit`, or `dash-e2e`
suites, and stops the runtime. Runtime tests need the local
database and other services; a successful health check alone is not test success.

Evaluation runs the official tests before and after your changes. The intended
acceptance rule requires all selected fail-to-pass tests to pass after your changes
and all selected pass-to-pass tests to remain passing. Collection failures and
missing selected results are not passes.

Package release status: current-input calibration produced candidate F2P/P2P
lists, but maintainer acceptance and scoring-list freeze are pending. This
migration scope is not a claim that the benchmark has been released. Formal
grading remains disabled until the candidate is accepted and frozen.

content.content:
# Changelog

All notable, unreleased changes to this project will be documented in this file. For the released changes, please visit the [Releases](https://github.com/saleor/saleor/releases) page.

# 3.22.0

### Breaking changes
- The following changes were implemented to orders with a zero total amount:
  - No manual charge (`Transaction` or `Payment`) object will be created.
  - The `OrderEvents.ORDER_MARKED_AS_PAID` event will no longer be emitted.
- Logic associated with `WebhookEventAsyncType.CHECKOUT_FULLY_PAID` event will no longer be triggered when creating a transaction event from webhook response for checkouts with having total gross being 0. At the point of creating the transaction event checkout is already considered fully paid.
- Creating a Payment (old API) for a Checkout object with an existing Transaction (new API) is no longer permitted as it leads to inconsistent behavior.
- Webhooks are no longer triggered for deactivated Apps.

### GraphQL API

#### Data Modeling

> [!NOTE]
> Please note that Pages were renamed to Models (same Page types to Model types). This change was already made in Saleor Dashboard, but is not yet reflected in the API

- You can now filter and search Models (previously named "Pages") using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `pages` query.
  - The `where` argument supports `AND`/`OR` logic and explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`, `range`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `page_types` (now `page_type`), `slugs` (now `slug`), `metadata`.
  - New filtering options available only in `where`:
    - `attributes` - Filter by attributes associated with the page, including:
      - Filter by attribute slug and name
      - Filter by numeric attribute values (with `eq`, `oneOf`, `range` operators)
      - Filter by boolean attribute values
      - Filter by date and datetime attribute values
      - Filter by reference attributes to pages, products, product variants, categories, and collections (by IDs or slugs)
      - Support for `contains_all` (page must reference ALL specified objects) and `contains_any` (page must reference at least ONE specified object)
  - The `search` parameter is now a standalone argument (previously `filter.search`). It works the same as before, searching across page title, slug, and content.
- Extend `AttributeEntityType` with `CATEGORY` and `COLLECTION`. You can now assign categories and collections as an attribute reference.
- You can now filter and search attribute choices using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `attribute.choices` query.
  - The `where` argument supports explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `slugs` (now `slug`).
  - New filtering options available only in `where`:
    - `name` - Filter by attribute choice name.
  - The `search` parameter is now a standalone argument (previously `filter.search`), searching across attribute choice name and slug.
- Added new `SINGLE_REFERENCE` attribute type. You can now create a reference attribute that points to only one object (unlike the existing `REFERENCE` type, which supports multiple references). They can target the same entities as `REFERENCE` attributes (defined in the `AttributeEntityTypeEnum`).
- Extended support for filtering `products` by associated attributes in the `where` parameter:
  - **Attribute slug is now optional**: When filtering by attribute values, you no longer need to specify which attribute to search. This allows you to search across all attributes of a given type. This is especially useful for reference attributes when you want to find any product that references a specific object, regardless of which attribute contains that reference.
  - **Filter by reference attribute values**: Products can now be filtered by the objects they reference through `REFERENCE` and `SINGLE_REFERENCE` type attributes. You can filter by:
    - `referencedIds` - Global IDs of any referenced entity (Product, ProductVariant, Page, Category, Collection). Use this to search across multiple entity types in a single filter.
    - `productSlugs` - Slugs of referenced products
    - `productVariantSkus` - SKUs of referenced product variants
    - `pageSlugs` - Slugs of referenced pages
    - `categorySlugs` - Slugs of referenced categories
    - `collectionSlugs` - Slugs of referenced collections
  - **Two matching strategies** are available for all reference filters:
    - `containsAny` - Returns products that reference at least ONE of the specified objects (OR logic)
    - `containsAll` - Returns products that reference ALL of the specified objects (AND logic)
- Added support for filtering `productVariants` by associated attributes in the `where` parameter with the same capabilities as products (see details above):
  - **Attribute slug is optional**: Filter variants without specifying which attribute to search
  - **Filter by reference attributes**: All reference filtering options are available (`referencedIds`, `productSlugs`, `productVariantSkus`, `pageSlugs`, `categorySlugs`, `collectionSlugs`)
  - **Two matching strategies**: Use `containsAny` or `containsAll` operators
- You can now use the `AssignedAttribute` interface and the `assignedAttribute`, `assignedAttributes` fields on `Page`, `Product`, and `ProductVariant` to fetch assigned attributes and their values in a cleaner, more focused shape.
  - `attribute` and `attributes` fields on Page, Product, and ProductVariant are deprecated.
- Added `referenceTypes` field on `Attribute` to restrict available reference choices for `REFERENCE` and `SINGLE_REFERENCE` attributes:
  - For `PRODUCT`/`PRODUCT_VARIANT` entity types: Accepts list of `ProductType` IDs to limit selectable products/variants to those types.
  - For `PAGE` entity type: Accepts list of `PageType` IDs (now shown as "Model types") to limit selectable models (previously pages) to those types.
  - When not specified, all objects of the entity type are available.
  - Can be set via `attributeCreate`, `attributeUpdate`, `attributeBulkCreate`, and `attributeBulkUpdate` mutations.
- Added `RefundSettings` for configuring required refund reasons globally. You can now require staff to provide structured refund reasons using any custom Model type (PageType in API):
  - Use `refundSettingsUpdate` mutation to set a `PageType` as the reason reference type. Create Models of this type representing your refund reasons (e.g., "Defective Product", "Wrong Item Shipped")
  - Once configured, staff users must provide a `reasonReference` (Page ID of that type) when creating refunds via `orderGrantRefundCreate`, `orderGrantRefundUpdate`, `orderRefund`, `fulfillmentRefundProducts`, and `transactionRequestAction` mutations
  - Use `refundReasonReferenceTypeClear` mutation to disable the requirement
  - Apps are not required to provide reasons, only staff users
  - This allows you to standardize and track refund reasons across your organization

#### Enhanced Filtering & Search

- You can now filter and search orders using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `orders` query.
  - The `where` argument supports `AND`/`OR` logic and explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`, `range`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `channels` (now `channel_id`), `customer`, `created` (now `created_at`), `updated_at`, `status`, `authorize_status`, `charge_status`, `payment_status`, `is_click_and_collect`, `is_preorder`, `checkout_tokens` (now `checkout_token`), `checkout_ids` (now `checkout_id`), `gift_card_used` (now `is_gift_card_used`), `gift_card_bought` (now `is_gift_card_bought`), `numbers` (now `number`), `metadata`.

# Changelog

All notable, unreleased changes to this project will be documented in this file. For the released changes, please visit the [Releases](https://github.com/saleor/saleor/releases) page.

# 3.22.0

### Breaking changes
- The following changes were implemented to orders with a zero total amount:
  - No manual charge (`Transaction` or `Payment`) object will be created.
  - The `OrderEvents.ORDER_MARKED_AS_PAID` event will no longer be emitted.
- Logic associated with `WebhookEventAsyncType.CHECKOUT_FULLY_PAID` event will no longer be triggered when creating a transaction event from webhook response for checkouts with having total gross being 0. At the point of creating the transaction event checkout is already considered fully paid.
- Creating a Payment (old API) for a Checkout object with an existing Transaction (new API) is no longer permitted as it leads to inconsistent behavior.
- Webhooks are no longer triggered for deactivated Apps.

### GraphQL API

#### Data Modeling

> [!NOTE]
> Please note that Pages were renamed to Models (same Page types to Model types). This change was already made in Saleor Dashboard, but is not yet reflected in the API

- You can now filter and search Models (previously named "Pages") using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `pages` query.
  - The `where` argument supports `AND`/`OR` logic and explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`, `range`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `page_types` (now `page_type`), `slugs` (now `slug`), `metadata`.
  - New filtering options available only in `where`:
    - `attributes` - Filter by attributes associated with the page, including:
      - Filter by attribute slug and name
      - Filter by numeric attribute values (with `eq`, `oneOf`, `range` operators)
      - Filter by boolean attribute values
      - Filter by date and datetime attribute values
      - Filter by reference attributes to pages, products, product variants, categories, and collections (by IDs or slugs)
      - Support for `contains_all` (page must reference ALL specified objects) and `contains_any` (page must reference at least ONE specified object)
  - The `search` parameter is now a standalone argument (previously `filter.search`). It works the same as before, searching across page title, slug, and content.
- Extend `AttributeEntityType` with `CATEGORY` and `COLLECTION`. You can now assign categories and collections as an attribute reference.
- You can now filter and search attribute choices using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `attribute.choices` query.
  - The `where` argument supports explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `slugs` (now `slug`).
  - New filtering options available only in `where`:
    - `name` - Filter by attribute choice name.
  - The `search` parameter is now a standalone argument (previously `filter.search`), searching across attribute choice name and slug.
- Added new `SINGLE_REFERENCE` attribute type. You can now create a reference attribute that points to only one object (unlike the existing `REFERENCE` type, which supports multiple references). They can target the same entities as `REFERENCE` attributes (defined in the `AttributeEntityTypeEnum`).
- Extended support for filtering `products` by associated attributes in the `where` parameter:
  - **Attribute slug is now optional**: When filtering by attribute values, you no longer need to specify which attribute to search. This allows you to search across all attributes of a given type. This is especially useful for reference attributes when you want to find any product that references a specific object, regardless of which attribute contains that reference.
  - **Filter by reference attribute values**: Products can now be filtered by the objects they reference through `REFERENCE` and `SINGLE_REFERENCE` type attributes. You can filter by:
    - `referencedIds` - Global IDs of any referenced entity (Product, ProductVariant, Page, Category, Collection). Use this to search across multiple entity types in a single filter.
    - `productSlugs` - Slugs of referenced products
    - `productVariantSkus` - SKUs of referenced product variants
    - `pageSlugs` - Slugs of referenced pages
    - `categorySlugs` - Slugs of referenced categories
    - `collectionSlugs` - Slugs of referenced collections
  - **Two matching strategies** are available for all reference filters:
    - `containsAny` - Returns products that reference at least ONE of the specified objects (OR logic)
    - `containsAll` - Returns products that reference ALL of the specified objects (AND logic)
- Added support for filtering `productVariants` by associated attributes in the `where` parameter with the same capabilities as products (see details above):
  - **Attribute slug is optional**: Filter variants without specifying which attribute to search
  - **Filter by reference attributes**: All reference filtering options are available (`referencedIds`, `productSlugs`, `productVariantSkus`, `pageSlugs`, `categorySlugs`, `collectionSlugs`)
  - **Two matching strategies**: Use `containsAny` or `containsAll` operators
- You can now use the `AssignedAttribute` interface and the `assignedAttribute`, `assignedAttributes` fields on `Page`, `Product`, and `ProductVariant` to fetch assigned attributes and their values in a cleaner, more focused shape.
  - `attribute` and `attributes` fields on Page, Product, and ProductVariant are deprecated.
- Added `referenceTypes` field on `Attribute` to restrict available reference choices for `REFERENCE` and `SINGLE_REFERENCE` attributes:
  - For `PRODUCT`/`PRODUCT_VARIANT` entity types: Accepts list of `ProductType` IDs to limit selectable products/variants to those types.
  - For `PAGE` entity type: Accepts list of `PageType` IDs (now shown as "Model types") to limit selectable models (previously pages) to those types.
  - When not specified, all objects of the entity type are available.
  - Can be set via `attributeCreate`, `attributeUpdate`, `attributeBulkCreate`, and `attributeBulkUpdate` mutations.
- Added `RefundSettings` for configuring required refund reasons globally. You can now require staff to provide structured refund reasons using any custom Model type (PageType in API):
  - Use `refundSettingsUpdate` mutation to set a `PageType` as the reason reference type. Create Models of this type representing your refund reasons (e.g., "Defective Product", "Wrong Item Shipped")
  - Once configured, staff users must provide a `reasonReference` (Page ID of that type) when creating refunds via `orderGrantRefundCreate`, `orderGrantRefundUpdate`, `orderRefund`, `fulfillmentRefundProducts`, and `transactionRequestAction` mutations
  - Use `refundReasonReferenceTypeClear` mutation to disable the requirement
  - Apps are not required to provide reasons, only staff users
  - This allows you to standardize and track refund reasons across your organization

#### Enhanced Filtering & Search

- You can now filter and search orders using the new `where` and `search` fields on the `orders` query.
  - The `where` argument supports `AND`/`OR` logic and explicit operators (`eq`, `oneOf`, `range`) for all fields.
  - Existing `filter` fields remain available in `where`: `ids`, `channels` (now `channel_id`), `customer`, `created` (now `created_at`), `updated_at`, `status`, `authorize_status`, `charge_status`, `payment_status`, `is_click_and_collect`, `is_preorder`, `checkout_tokens` (now `checkout_token`), `checkout_ids` (now `checkout_id`), `gift_card_used` (now `is_gift_card_used`), `gift_card_bought` (now `is_gift_card_bought`), `numbers` (now `number`), `metadata`.
  - New filtering options available only in `where`:
    - `user` - Filter by user ID.
    - `user_email` - Filter by user email.
    - `voucher_code` - Filter by voucher code used in the order.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

round=$1
shift

export SECRET_KEY=${SECRET_KEY:-sdlcbench-local-test-key}
export E2E_USER_PASSWORD=${E2E_USER_PASSWORD:-admin}
export E2E_PERMISSIONS_USERS_PASSWORD=${E2E_PERMISSIONS_USERS_PASSWORD:-password}
export RUNTIME_LOG_DIR="/logs/verifier/runtime-$round"
export RUNTIME_STATE_DIR
RUNTIME_STATE_DIR=$(mktemp -d /tmp/sdlcbench-runtime.XXXXXX)
chmod 755 "$RUNTIME_STATE_DIR"
mkdir -p "$RUNTIME_LOG_DIR"

run_suite() (
  suite=$1
  out="/logs/verifier/$suite-$round"
  mkdir -p "$out"
  export OUT="$out"
  case "$suite" in
  core-smoke|core-unit|core-e2e)
    cd /workspace/saleor
    unset CELERY_BROKER_URL EMAIL_URL
    if [ "$TEST_SUITE" = base ]; then unset CACHE_URL; fi
    args=(--continue-on-collection-errors --maxfail=0 --allow-hosts localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,cache -n 2 --junitxml="$out/results.xml" -o junit_family=legacy)
    case "$suite" in
      core-smoke) args+=(saleor/core/tests/test_core.py saleor/core/tests/test_weight.py) ;;
      core-unit) args+=(-m 'not e2e') ;;
      core-e2e) args+=(-m e2e) ;;
    esac
    pytest "${args[@]}"
    ;;
  dash-unit)
    cd /workspace/saleor-dashboard
    args=(--maxWorkers=2 --json --outputFile="$out/results.json")
    if [ "$TEST_SUITE" = base ]; then
      args+=(--transformIgnorePatterns 'node_modules/(?!\.pnpm|chroma-js|zod|popper\.js)')
    fi
    node_modules/.bin/jest "${args[@]}"
    ;;

from django.core.serializers.json import Serializer as JsonSerializer
from draftjs_sanitizer import SafeJSONEncoder
from measurement.measures import Weight
from prices import Money

MONEY_TYPE = "Money"


class Serializer(JsonSerializer):
    def _init_options(self):
        super()._init_options()  # type: ignore[misc] # private method
        self.json_kwargs["cls"] = CustomJsonEncoder


class CustomJsonEncoder(DjangoJSONEncoder):
    def default(self, obj):
        if isinstance(obj, Money):
            return {"_type": MONEY_TYPE, "amount": obj.amount, "currency": obj.currency}
        # Mirror implementation of django_measurement.MeasurementField.value_to_string
        if isinstance(obj, Weight):
            return f"{obj.value}:{obj.unit}"
        return super().default(obj)


class HTMLSafeJSON(SafeJSONEncoder, DjangoJSONEncoder):
    """Escape dangerous characters from JSON.

    serializing Django objects.
    """

# PRD：Saleor Core 与 Dashboard 3.23.0 协同迁移

版本：v1
责任：产品
状态：需求范围与验收条件已定义
输入：instruction.md；现有项目代码
修订：首次交付

## 1. 业务背景与目标

Saleor 商家平台由两个仓库协同构成：`saleor`（核心后端，对外提供 GraphQL API）与 `saleor-dashboard`（商家管理前端，其 GraphQL 客户端类型由核心 schema 生成）。两者通过 GraphQL 契约强耦合：后端新增/删除字段、类型与枚举，前端必须同步重新生成客户端产物；前端升级所依赖的字段，后端必须实际提供。

当前工作区基线为 core `3.22.0`、dashboard `3.22.9`，目标版本为 `3.23.0`。本次需求是把两个仓库**协同升级到 3.23.0**：后端 API 与 Dashboard 行为保持一致，涵盖 GraphQL 契约、生成的客户端产物、数据库迁移以及构建/依赖声明；在实现目标行为的同时，保留回归测试所覆盖的既有行为；不得用测试专用桩替代缺失的生产功能。

目标：

1. 两仓库版本标识、GraphQL 契约、数据库迁移与依赖声明全部对齐到 3.23.0，且相互一致（前端不引用后端不存在的字段，后端不遗漏前端已使用的字段）。
2. 迁移过程中商家侧关键操作路径（登录、产品/订单/渠道/应用扩展管理等）与既有测试覆盖的行为不发生回归。
3. 全程离线完成：不抓取目标源码、不联网安装依赖；改动以普通源码提交形式落在工作树中，可导出相对固定基线的 diff。

依据：`instruction.md` 明确要求在两仓库实施协调的生产代码迁移，并列举了契约、生成产物、迁移与构建声明四类一致性对象；其中亦声明当前 benchmark 的 F2P/P2P 名单尚未冻结，因此本 PRD 不引用任何未发布的指标。本次没有可用的业务量化指标数据，故不编造指标。

## 2. 用户与场景

| 用户类型 | 典型任务 | 迁移影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 商家运营人员（Dashboard 使用者） | 登录后台、维护产品与库存、处理订单、配置渠道与配送、安装与管理 App 扩展、编辑富文本描述与页面内容 | 升级后上述操作路径与交互结果不回归；富文本、图标、通知、日期展示等基础能力保持一致 |
| 第三方 App 开发者 / 集成方 | 依据 GraphQL 契约开发应用；读取 App 扩展的挂载点、打开目标与设置 | 契约字段（如 AppExtension 的 `mountName`/`targetName`/`settings`）必须在后端真实可用，废弃字段需有明确的 deprecated 说明 |
| 平台运维 / 发布负责人 | 部署新版本、执行数据库迁移、管理依赖与构建产物 | 迁移可升级可回滚、依赖声明可离线复现、版本标识正确 |
| 质量工程 / 评测执行者 | 运行 core-unit、core-e2e、dash-unit、dash-e2e 四个套件 | 套件可运行；fail-to-pass 通过、pass-to-pass 保持；评测物料不被改动 |

## 3. 需求条目

### 业务域 A：版本与发布基线

#### R01 · 双仓库版本与 schema 版本升级到 3.23.0

- 来源：Instruction「The baselines are core 3.22.0 and dashboard 3.22.9; the intended target is 3.23.0.」「Implement the coordinated production-code migration to 3.23.0 across both repositories.」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：把两个仓库的版本标识统一提升到 3.23.0。后端以 `saleor/__init__.py` 的 `__version__` 为单一事实来源，并由其派生 `schema_version` 与 `user_agent_version`；`pyproject.toml` 的项目版本同步。前端提升 `package.json` 的 `version`，并把用于拉取/生成契约的 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 指向 3.23。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-01-1：读取 `saleor/__init__.py`，`__version__` 为 `"3.23.0"`；由其派生的 `schema_version` 为 `"3.23"`，`user_agent_version` 为 `"Saleor/3.23"`。
  - AC-01-2：`pyproject.toml` 中 `[project]` 的 `version` 为 `"3.23.0"`。
  - AC-01-3：`saleor-dashboard/package.json` 中 `version` 为 `"3.23.0"`，`config.saleor.schemaVersion` 为 `"3.23"`。
  - AC-01-4：两仓库版本号一致，且改动后的 diff 中不存在把版本号改回 3.22 的修改。

### 业务域 B：GraphQL 契约与生成产物

#### R02 · core GraphQL schema 与 Dashboard 期望契约对齐

- 来源：Instruction「Keep the backend API and Dashboard behavior consistent, including their GraphQL contracts, generated client artifacts…」；推导依据：工作区内 dashboard `schema.graphql` 与 core `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql` 存在契约差异——dashboard 侧 `AppExtension` 已包含 `mountName`、`targetName`、`settings`，而 core 侧 `saleor/graphql/app/types.py` 仍只有 `mount`/`target`/`options`。
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：core 必须以代码为准生成并提交最新 `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql`，并补齐 dashboard 已在使用、但当前后端尚未提供的扩展字段：`AppExtension`（及 `AppManifestExtension`）提供 `mountName: String!`、`targetName: String!`、`settings: JSON!`，同时把 `mount`、`target`、`options` 标记为 deprecated 并指向替代字段；`WidgetTargetOptions.widgetTarget`、`NewTabTargetOptions.newTabTarget`、`HttpMethod.method` 同样标记 deprecated 并指向 `settings`。前端不得引用后端在 3.23 中已移除的字段。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-02-1：由 core 代码导出的 schema 与仓库内 `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql` 完全一致（导出结果与文件 diff 为空）。
  - AC-02-2：schema 中 `AppExtension` 暴露 `mountName: String!`、`targetName: String!`、`settings: JSON!`；`mount`、`target`、`options` 带 `@deprecated` 且 reason 指向替代字段。
  - AC-02-3：schema 中 `AppExtensionOptionsWidget.widgetTarget`、`AppExtensionOptionsNewTab.newTabTarget`、`HttpMethod.method` 带 `@deprecated`。
  - AC-02-4：dashboard 端所有 GraphQL 文档（`src/**/queries.ts`、`src/**/mutations.ts`、`src/**/fragments/*.ts`、`src/searches/*.ts`）在 3.23 schema 上校验通过，无未知字段、类型或参数错误。
  - AC-02-5：dashboard 中不再存在对 3.23 已删除契约的引用（例如 Adyen 相关支付类型/字段，若在该版本中被移除）。

#### R03 · Dashboard 客户端产物按 3.23 契约重新生成

- 来源：Instruction「…generated client artifacts…」；推导依据：`saleor-dashboard/package.json` 现有 `generate`（`graphql-codegen`，配置 `codegen.ts`）与 `fetch-schema`（按 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 拉取 schema）脚本，以及 `src/graphql/` 下已提交的生成文件。
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：dashboard 以 3.23 契约重新生成 `src/graphql/types.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/hooks.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/fragmentTypes.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/typePolicies.generated.ts`，生成结果必须与手写代码、现有查询文档自洽；同时按目标工程的流程，把契约来源区分为「版本化主契约」（按 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 拉取）与「main 分支 staging 契约」两条独立链路，两者各自产出、互不覆盖。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-03-1：在离线环境下执行生成命令（主契约链路）成功，产出的 `src/graphql/*.generated.ts` 与仓库中提交的内容一致；重复执行无 diff（生成结果稳定、可复现）。
  - AC-03-2：`package.json` 中主契约链路使用 `schemaVersion = 3.23` 的 schema 文件，staging 链路使用 main 分支 schema；两条链路的 schema 文件与生成产物互不覆盖。
  - AC-03-3：`pnpm run check-types` 通过；`pnpm run lint` 不因本次契约变更产生新错误。
  - AC-03-4：dashboard 单测（jest）中不出现因类型/字段缺失导致的编译或运行失败。

### 业务域 C：数据库迁移

#### R04 · 模型变更伴随数据库迁移且迁移图保持可升级

- 来源：Instruction「…database migrations…」「Preserve existing behavior covered by regression tests…」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：本迁移中所有 Django 模型变更（尤其因支付网关移除而产生的字段删除）必须提供对应迁移文件；迁移图保持线性、可升级与可回滚；不得修改已发布的历史迁移文件，只允许新增。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-04-1：执行 `python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run` 无待生成迁移（模型与迁移文件一致）。
  - AC-04-2：新增迁移可在 3.22 基线的数据库上成功 upgrade，并可成功 downgrade 回退。
  - AC-04-3：`saleor/*/migrations/` 下不存在对既有迁移文件的修改，只有新增文件。
  - AC-04-4：在干净数据库与 3.22 基线数据库上执行 `python manage.py migrate` 均成功，迁移图无分叉或冲突。

### 业务域 D：后端功能迁移

#### R05 · 移除 Adyen 支付网关及其遗留字段

- 来源：推导依据（三处一致指向同一结论）：① 目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 删除 `Adyen>=4.0.0,<5`；② `saleor/settings.py` 的 `BUILTIN_PLUGINS` 注册了 `saleor.payment.gateways.adyen.plugin.AdyenGatewayPlugin`；③ `saleor/payment/models.py` 中遗留字段注释写明「Legacy fields that allow Adyen plugin to work until it's removed… Once plugin is removed, these fields should be removed from the model.」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：删除 Adyen 支付网关实现及其测试，解除插件注册与相关依赖；按模型注释指明的清理路径，删除仅为 Adyen 保留的 `Transaction` 遗留字段 `legacy_adyen_plugin_result_code`、`legacy_adyen_plugin_payment_method`，并提供对应迁移（见 R04）。除 Adyen 外的支付网关能力保持不变。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-05-1：`saleor/payment/gateways/adyen/`（含其测试）不再存在；生产代码中不存在对 `AdyenGatewayPlugin` 的引用。
  - AC-05-2：`settings` 的 `BUILTIN_PLUGINS`（进而 `PLUGINS`）中不再包含 `saleor.payment.gateways.adyen.plugin.AdyenGatewayPlugin`。

- 后端 Adyen 移除会连带影响支付模型字段与迁移，属于不可逆的 API 面收缩，必须与 R02/R03 的契约再生成同一批次完成，避免出现「后端已删、前端仍引用」的中间态。

# PRD：Saleor Core 与 Dashboard 3.23.0 协同迁移

版本：v1
责任：产品
状态：需求范围与验收条件已定义
输入：instruction.md；现有项目代码
修订：首次交付

## 1. 业务背景与目标

Saleor 商家平台由两个仓库协同构成：`saleor`（核心后端，对外提供 GraphQL API）与 `saleor-dashboard`（商家管理前端，其 GraphQL 客户端类型由核心 schema 生成）。两者通过 GraphQL 契约强耦合：后端新增/删除字段、类型与枚举，前端必须同步重新生成客户端产物；前端升级所依赖的字段，后端必须实际提供。

当前工作区基线为 core `3.22.0`、dashboard `3.22.9`，目标版本为 `3.23.0`。本次需求是把两个仓库**协同升级到 3.23.0**：后端 API 与 Dashboard 行为保持一致，涵盖 GraphQL 契约、生成的客户端产物、数据库迁移以及构建/依赖声明；在实现目标行为的同时，保留回归测试所覆盖的既有行为；不得用测试专用桩替代缺失的生产功能。

目标：

1. 两仓库版本标识、GraphQL 契约、数据库迁移与依赖声明全部对齐到 3.23.0，且相互一致（前端不引用后端不存在的字段，后端不遗漏前端已使用的字段）。
2. 迁移过程中商家侧关键操作路径（登录、产品/订单/渠道/应用扩展管理等）与既有测试覆盖的行为不发生回归。
3. 全程离线完成：不抓取目标源码、不联网安装依赖；改动以普通源码提交形式落在工作树中，可导出相对固定基线的 diff。

依据：`instruction.md` 明确要求在两仓库实施协调的生产代码迁移，并列举了契约、生成产物、迁移与构建声明四类一致性对象；其中亦声明当前 benchmark 的 F2P/P2P 名单尚未冻结，因此本 PRD 不引用任何未发布的指标。本次没有可用的业务量化指标数据，故不编造指标。

## 2. 用户与场景

| 用户类型 | 典型任务 | 迁移影响 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 商家运营人员（Dashboard 使用者） | 登录后台、维护产品与库存、处理订单、配置渠道与配送、安装与管理 App 扩展、编辑富文本描述与页面内容 | 升级后上述操作路径与交互结果不回归；富文本、图标、通知、日期展示等基础能力保持一致 |
| 第三方 App 开发者 / 集成方 | 依据 GraphQL 契约开发应用；读取 App 扩展的挂载点、打开目标与设置 | 契约字段（如 AppExtension 的 `mountName`/`targetName`/`settings`）必须在后端真实可用，废弃字段需有明确的 deprecated 说明 |
| 平台运维 / 发布负责人 | 部署新版本、执行数据库迁移、管理依赖与构建产物 | 迁移可升级可回滚、依赖声明可离线复现、版本标识正确 |
| 质量工程 / 评测执行者 | 运行 core-unit、core-e2e、dash-unit、dash-e2e 四个套件 | 套件可运行；fail-to-pass 通过、pass-to-pass 保持；评测物料不被改动 |

## 3. 需求条目

### 业务域 A：版本与发布基线

#### R01 · 双仓库版本与 schema 版本升级到 3.23.0

- 来源：Instruction「The baselines are core 3.22.0 and dashboard 3.22.9; the intended target is 3.23.0.」「Implement the coordinated production-code migration to 3.23.0 across both repositories.」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：把两个仓库的版本标识统一提升到 3.23.0。后端以 `saleor/__init__.py` 的 `__version__` 为单一事实来源，并由其派生 `schema_version` 与 `user_agent_version`；`pyproject.toml` 的项目版本同步。前端提升 `package.json` 的 `version`，并把用于拉取/生成契约的 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 指向 3.23。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-01-1：读取 `saleor/__init__.py`，`__version__` 为 `"3.23.0"`；由其派生的 `schema_version` 为 `"3.23"`，`user_agent_version` 为 `"Saleor/3.23"`。
  - AC-01-2：`pyproject.toml` 中 `[project]` 的 `version` 为 `"3.23.0"`。
  - AC-01-3：`saleor-dashboard/package.json` 中 `version` 为 `"3.23.0"`，`config.saleor.schemaVersion` 为 `"3.23"`。
  - AC-01-4：两仓库版本号一致，且改动后的 diff 中不存在把版本号改回 3.22 的修改。

### 业务域 B：GraphQL 契约与生成产物

#### R02 · core GraphQL schema 与 Dashboard 期望契约对齐

- 来源：Instruction「Keep the backend API and Dashboard behavior consistent, including their GraphQL contracts, generated client artifacts…」；推导依据：工作区内 dashboard `schema.graphql` 与 core `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql` 存在契约差异——dashboard 侧 `AppExtension` 已包含 `mountName`、`targetName`、`settings`，而 core 侧 `saleor/graphql/app/types.py` 仍只有 `mount`/`target`/`options`。
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：core 必须以代码为准生成并提交最新 `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql`，并补齐 dashboard 已在使用、但当前后端尚未提供的扩展字段：`AppExtension`（及 `AppManifestExtension`）提供 `mountName: String!`、`targetName: String!`、`settings: JSON!`，同时把 `mount`、`target`、`options` 标记为 deprecated 并指向替代字段；`WidgetTargetOptions.widgetTarget`、`NewTabTargetOptions.newTabTarget`、`HttpMethod.method` 同样标记 deprecated 并指向 `settings`。前端不得引用后端在 3.23 中已移除的字段。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-02-1：由 core 代码导出的 schema 与仓库内 `saleor/graphql/schema.graphql` 完全一致（导出结果与文件 diff 为空）。
  - AC-02-2：schema 中 `AppExtension` 暴露 `mountName: String!`、`targetName: String!`、`settings: JSON!`；`mount`、`target`、`options` 带 `@deprecated` 且 reason 指向替代字段。
  - AC-02-3：schema 中 `AppExtensionOptionsWidget.widgetTarget`、`AppExtensionOptionsNewTab.newTabTarget`、`HttpMethod.method` 带 `@deprecated`。
  - AC-02-4：dashboard 端所有 GraphQL 文档（`src/**/queries.ts`、`src/**/mutations.ts`、`src/**/fragments/*.ts`、`src/searches/*.ts`）在 3.23 schema 上校验通过，无未知字段、类型或参数错误。
  - AC-02-5：dashboard 中不再存在对 3.23 已删除契约的引用（例如 Adyen 相关支付类型/字段，若在该版本中被移除）。

#### R03 · Dashboard 客户端产物按 3.23 契约重新生成

- 来源：Instruction「…generated client artifacts…」；推导依据：`saleor-dashboard/package.json` 现有 `generate`（`graphql-codegen`，配置 `codegen.ts`）与 `fetch-schema`（按 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 拉取 schema）脚本，以及 `src/graphql/` 下已提交的生成文件。
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：dashboard 以 3.23 契约重新生成 `src/graphql/types.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/hooks.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/fragmentTypes.generated.ts`、`src/graphql/typePolicies.generated.ts`，生成结果必须与手写代码、现有查询文档自洽；同时按目标工程的流程，把契约来源区分为「版本化主契约」（按 `config.saleor.schemaVersion` 拉取）与「main 分支 staging 契约」两条独立链路，两者各自产出、互不覆盖。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-03-1：在离线环境下执行生成命令（主契约链路）成功，产出的 `src/graphql/*.generated.ts` 与仓库中提交的内容一致；重复执行无 diff（生成结果稳定、可复现）。
  - AC-03-2：`package.json` 中主契约链路使用 `schemaVersion = 3.23` 的 schema 文件，staging 链路使用 main 分支 schema；两条链路的 schema 文件与生成产物互不覆盖。
  - AC-03-3：`pnpm run check-types` 通过；`pnpm run lint` 不因本次契约变更产生新错误。
  - AC-03-4：dashboard 单测（jest）中不出现因类型/字段缺失导致的编译或运行失败。

### 业务域 C：数据库迁移

#### R04 · 模型变更伴随数据库迁移且迁移图保持可升级

- 来源：Instruction「…database migrations…」「Preserve existing behavior covered by regression tests…」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：本迁移中所有 Django 模型变更（尤其因支付网关移除而产生的字段删除）必须提供对应迁移文件；迁移图保持线性、可升级与可回滚；不得修改已发布的历史迁移文件，只允许新增。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-04-1：执行 `python manage.py makemigrations --check --dry-run` 无待生成迁移（模型与迁移文件一致）。
  - AC-04-2：新增迁移可在 3.22 基线的数据库上成功 upgrade，并可成功 downgrade 回退。
  - AC-04-3：`saleor/*/migrations/` 下不存在对既有迁移文件的修改，只有新增文件。
  - AC-04-4：在干净数据库与 3.22 基线数据库上执行 `python manage.py migrate` 均成功，迁移图无分叉或冲突。

### 业务域 D：后端功能迁移

#### R05 · 移除 Adyen 支付网关及其遗留字段

- 来源：推导依据（三处一致指向同一结论）：① 目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 删除 `Adyen>=4.0.0,<5`；② `saleor/settings.py` 的 `BUILTIN_PLUGINS` 注册了 `saleor.payment.gateways.adyen.plugin.AdyenGatewayPlugin`；③ `saleor/payment/models.py` 中遗留字段注释写明「Legacy fields that allow Adyen plugin to work until it's removed… Once plugin is removed, these fields should be removed from the model.」
- 优先级：P0
- 需求描述：删除 Adyen 支付网关实现及其测试，解除插件注册与相关依赖；按模型注释指明的清理路径，删除仅为 Adyen 保留的 `Transaction` 遗留字段 `legacy_adyen_plugin_result_code`、`legacy_adyen_plugin_payment_method`，并提供对应迁移（见 R04）。除 Adyen 外的支付网关能力保持不变。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-05-1：`saleor/payment/gateways/adyen/`（含其测试）不再存在；生产代码中不存在对 `AdyenGatewayPlugin` 的引用。
  - AC-05-2：`settings` 的 `BUILTIN_PLUGINS`（进而 `PLUGINS`）中不再包含 `saleor.payment.gateways.adyen.plugin.AdyenGatewayPlugin`。
  - AC-05-3：生产代码中不再写入 `legacy_adyen_plugin_result_code`、`legacy_adyen_plugin_payment_method`；这两个模型字段经新增迁移删除，`makemigrations --check` 无残留（见 AC-04-1）。
  - AC-05-4：其余支付网关（`stripe`、`braintree`、`razorpay`、`authorize_net`、`np_atobarai`、`dummy`、`dummy_credit_card`）的注册与行为与 3.22 一致，其单元测试全部通过。

#### R06 · 富文本序列化/消毒依赖替换（draftjs-sanitizer、html-to-draftjs → nh3）

- 来源：推导依据：目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 删除 `draftjs-sanitizer>=1.0.0,<2`、`html-to-draftjs>=1.0.1,<2`，新增 `nh3>=0.2.20`；工作区中 `saleor/core/utils/json_serializer.py` 直接 `from draftjs_sanitizer import SafeJSONEncoder`，并被 `CustomJsonEncoder`/`HTMLSafeJSON` 体系使用。
- 优先级：P1
- 需求描述：移除对 `draftjs-sanitizer`、`html-to-draftjs` 的运行时依赖，改用目标版本声明的消毒能力（`nh3`）或等价的本仓实现，保持既有对外行为：富文本字段保存时的消毒结果、用于搜索与长度校验的纯文本转换结果、以及把 JSON 嵌入 HTML 时的字符转义行为均不得改变。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-06-1：代码与依赖声明中不再出现 `draftjs_sanitizer`、`html_to_draftjs`（历史迁移文件除外）。
  - AC-06-2：`Product`、`Category`、`Collection`、`Page`、`AttributeValue`、`Discount`、`ShippingMethod` 等富文本字段在保存时仍执行消毒；非法 URL scheme（如 `javascript:`）被替换的行为与 3.22 一致。
  - AC-06-3：`clean_editor_js(..., to_string=True)` 仍返回去除标签的纯文本，供搜索向量与长度校验使用；相关单测通过。
  - AC-06-4：把 JSON 嵌入 HTML 的场景中，`<`、`>`、`&`、U+2028、U+2029 仍被转义；等价替换实现有单测覆盖。

#### R07 · 缩略图 AVIF 能力改用 Pillow 原生支持

- 来源：推导依据：目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 删除 `pillow-avif-plugin>=1.5.2,<2` 并把 `pillow` 提升到 `>=12.1.1,<13`；工作区 `saleor/__init__.py` 首行 `import pillow_avif`，`saleor/thumbnail/__init__.py` 的 `ThumbnailFormat` 含 `AVIF` 且列入 `ALLOWED_THUMBNAIL_FORMATS`。
- 优先级：P1
- 需求描述：去掉 `pillow_avif` 的副作用导入与依赖，由 Pillow 12 原生支持 AVIF；AVIF 格式的识别、上传校验与缩略图转换能力保持不变。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-07-1：`saleor/__init__.py` 不再导入 `pillow_avif`；依赖声明中不存在 `pillow-avif-plugin`。
  - AC-07-2：`ThumbnailFormat.AVIF` 与 `ALLOWED_THUMBNAIL_FORMATS` 保持不变；AVIF 图片的上传校验与缩略图生成路径行为与 3.22 一致，相关测试（含 `saleor/graphql/core/tests/test_file_validation.py` 中 AVIF 用例）通过。
  - AC-07-3：安装的 Pillow 版本满足 `>=12.1.1,<13`，且不引入额外 AVIF 插件包。

#### R08 · 移除 posuto，日本地址处理不回归

- 来源：推导依据：目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 删除 `posuto>=2025.1.0,<2026`；工作区 `saleor/payment/gateways/np_atobarai/api_helpers.py` 使用 `from posuto import Posuto` 由邮编解析日本地址。
- 优先级：P2
- 需求描述：去掉 `posuto` 依赖及其导入，np_atobarai 网关的地址处理逻辑在无本地邮编库的情况下仍能正常工作，且不因邮编解析失败而中断支付流程。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-08-1：依赖声明中不存在 `posuto`，生产代码中不存在 `posuto` 导入。
  - AC-08-2：np_atobarai 相关单元测试通过；地址处理在邮编无法解析时的降级行为明确（不抛出未捕获异常）。

#### R09 · 新增运行时依赖的接入

- 来源：推导依据：目标依赖清单中 core `pyproject.toml` 新增 `orjson>=3.11.4`、`idna>=3.10`、`kombu[sqs]>=4.6.11,<6.0.0`（`celery` 亦带 `sqs` extra）。
- 优先级：P2
- 需求描述：按目标声明引入上述依赖；若被用于替换既有实现（JSON 序列化、域名/主机名编码、Celery broker 传输），必须保证对外可观察行为（响应体、日志、任务投递语义）与 3.22 等价。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-09-1：依赖声明中包含 `orjson`、`idna`、`kombu[sqs]`，且可在离线环境中成功导入。
  - AC-09-2：引入后 GraphQL 响应与 Webhook/日志中的 JSON 内容与 3.22 等价（键与值语义一致），相关单测通过。

### 业务域 E：Dashboard 前端迁移

#### R10 · 移除 @saleor/sdk，改为本仓实现认证与客户端配置

- 来源：推导依据：① 目标依赖清单中 dashboard `package.json` 删除 `@saleor/sdk`；② 工作区代码内已标注迁移意图：`src/graphql/client.ts` 注释「TODO: Remove once @saleor/sdk is removed in favor of local implementation for auth」，且 `src/index.tsx`、`src/auth/**`、`src/utils/**` 等共 17 个文件引用该库。
- 优先级：P1
- 需求描述：移除 `@saleor/sdk` 依赖及其全部导入，用本仓实现等价能力：Apollo 客户端构造与 fetch 包装、Saleor 配置读取、认证状态与登录/刷新/登出、外部 access token、地址校验与元数据更新等辅助逻辑。对外行为（登录流程、token 刷新、权限与错误提示）保持与 3.22 一致。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-10-1：`package.json` 不再声明 `@saleor/sdk`；`src/`、`playwright/` 中不存在 `@saleor/sdk` 导入。
  - AC-10-2：`useAuthProvider`、`AuthProvider`、凭据管理、地址校验、元数据更新等既有单测通过；登录、登出、token 刷新、外部 access token 流程行为不变。
  - AC-10-3：`src/graphql/client.ts` 中「移除 @saleor/sdk」相关 TODO 被清除，客户端配置能力由本仓实现提供，类型检查通过。
  - AC-10-4：dashboard e2e 的登录/初始化用例（setup 项目）通过。

#### R11 · 图标体系统一到 lucide-react，移除 @material-ui/icons

- 来源：推导依据：① 目标依赖清单中 dashboard `package.json` 删除 `@material-ui/icons`；② 仓库内 lint 规则 `lint/rules/no-deprecated-icons.cjs` 明确要求「Avoid importing icons from @material-ui/icons. Use lucide-react instead.」，并在 `eslint.config.mjs` 中以 `local-rules/no-deprecated-icons` 生效；③ 当前有 9 个源文件引用 `@material-ui/icons`。
- 优先级：P1
- 需求描述：把 `@material-ui/icons` 的全部使用替换为 `lucide-react`（或仓库既有本地图标组件），移除该依赖；受影响的界面在视觉与交互上保持等价。
- 验收条件：
  - AC-11-1：`src/` 中不存在 `@material-ui/icons` 导入；受影响的 9 个文件（产品类型变体属性、产品库存卡片底部、翻译字段、App 组件挂件、国家列表、Chip、确认按钮、渠道分配策略、配置首页）改用 `lucide-react` 或本地图标。
  - AC-11-2：`package.json` 不再声明 `@material-ui/icons`；`local-rules/no-deprecated-icons` 校验无违规。
  - AC-11-3：上述受影响页面的既有 jest 测试通过，交互与展示无回归。

#### R12 · 前端基础能力依赖对齐（通知、日期、路由历史、动效、编辑器）
